Fence Provider/account/auth/token generations, coalesce a bounded process-budgeted queue off the reader, and persist through state domain methods. Never record generation tokens or impose account health/cooldown from passive frames.

Add a process parent to existing request reservations and the Codex observation queue. Default observation-only; explicit deployment cap, atomic parent/child growth, sticky child failure, unconditional shrink/drop and shared owner accounting. Aggregate metrics count logical retained bytes, not RSS. Codex independent owners now include manifest model/capability allocations and fixed index capacity; previous-response JSON, identity scope, index estimates and tombstones; idle/active WS read payloads, bounded queue/socket wrapper and pool index allowances; and referral session key/entry owners retained by in-flight clones. Image GET now admits before bounded payload allocation and binds a parent owner to the final Bytes view; HEAD retains full SHA integrity validation using at most a 64 KiB reusable buffer. Previous-response expansion borrows cached items through state/domain callbacks, admits selected clones and parse/merge/serialization working sets before allocation, moves current input rather than cloning, and transfers wire ownership into HTTP Bytes or WS turn reservations. Capacity errors are distinct from actual required-context misses and never authorize replay or Provider penalties. Temporary lookup scope keys and required-context tool-pair index allowances also remain admitted until their stages complete. The outer HTTP opaque previous-response ID copy is admitted before allocation; WS borrows that ID. Nested response bodies and the active request body move instead of deep cloning.
